who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor of task B of /tmp/plan/7-cold-disk.md, int-1112
what: Listing a build's roots lowered every body of every crate it linked, the standard library's included, to find the few items declared in blocks that are kept by name (`#[no_mangle]`, `#[used]`): the whole walk ran ExpressionStore::of on each body. A crate served from its image was also decoded whole into a heap DefMap unless BLAZE_DEF_MAP_PAGES=1 was set, so a sealed crate held its def map twice over and paid the decode on every cold start.
cost: about 1.2 s before the codegen walk of a hello-world and most of a warm front end's 2,531 MB (plan 7, section 1; estimates until the plan's commands run)
cause: what a crate keeps by name was computed from source in every database, never kept as a record of the crate, and the def map's paged reading was a switch beside the whole decode instead of the one way
class: a per-crate fact derived again from every body each session instead of written once with the crate's records; a new read path added beside the old one behind a switch
prevention: a fact of a sealed crate is a record keyed over its image (front_keys lists it); a read path that replaces another deletes it and its switch in the same change
fix: kept-roots record (kept/frozen.rs, kept_key) served and stored beside the impl tables; a served crate lowers only the record's owners, any other only bodies_declaring_roots; Part::DefMap left the image (key domain 8), the whole decode and BLAZE_DEF_MAP_PAGES are deleted. Tests: kept::tests (3 and a layout refusal), deps::tests a_served_crate_parses_no_file_and_decodes_no_def_map, a_layout_7_image_is_a_named_miss. Not yet compiled or run.
